LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 WORD CLASSES: NOUNS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which words can be formed from others?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify nouns formed from verbs and other nouns from a text
2. use nouns formed from verbs and other nouns in sentences

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 WORD CLASSES: NOUNS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify nouns formed from verbs and other nouns from a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use nouns formed from verbs and other nouns in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which words can be formed from others?
2. What changes when a word is formed from another?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify nouns formed from verbs and other nouns from a text
2. use nouns formed from verbs and other nouns in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
